title: external-task-envelope
description: Written by the controller once before dispatching a task to an external worker. Immutable — amendment creates a new envelope with supersedes_run_id pointing to the replaced one. Validated before dispatch.

schema_version.description: Schema version; always 1 for this version of the envelope

run_id.description: Unique run identifier. Resolved before dispatch; must not be empty. Format: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ-slug.

project_id.description: Project identifier, e.g. advanced-ai-workflows. Resolved before dispatch; must not be empty.

task_id.description: Task identifier within the run, e.g. phase-01-loop-02-todo-03. Must not be empty.

title.description: Human-readable task title. Must not be empty.

kind.description: Task kind. 'implementation' and 'sync' require isolation: worktree unless override_with_shared_write is true. 'sync' and 'release' require allowed_paths to be present.

isolation.description: Execution isolation level. 'worktree' = isolated git worktree; 'shared' = shared checkout (requires override_with_shared_write justification).

override_with_shared_write.description: If true, allows isolation: 'shared' for implementation or sync tasks. Controller must record explicit justification elsewhere. Rule 2: implementation/sync tasks must use worktree unless this is true.

provider.description: AI provider/CLI that will execute the task

manager.description: Execution manager. 'herdr' = herdr-managed pane; 'native' = direct CLI invocation.

repository.description: Absolute path to the repository root on the local filesystem. Resolved before dispatch; must not be empty.

base_ref.description: Human-readable git ref for the base branch, e.g. upstream/main or main. Resolved before dispatch; must not be empty. Rule 6: base_sha holds the resolved 40-character SHA.

base_sha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA resolved from base_ref before dispatch. Abbreviated SHAs must fail validation. Rule 6: this field exists because base_ref alone is insufficient — the SHA is the immutable anchor.

branch.description: Branch name for worker commits. Resolved before dispatch; must not be empty.

allowed_paths.description: Paths the worker is permitted to modify. Rule 3: required (non-empty array) for sync and release tasks; may be broad for other kinds.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths the worker must not touch. Rule 4: must contain '.advanced-plans/state/' — the controller's mutable planning state. Enforced via 'contains' with const.

spec_paths.description: Paths to specification documents the worker must read. May be empty if no specs apply.

acceptance_checks.description: Test commands or fixtures the worker must pass. Each entry is a human-readable check name or command.

required_evidence.description: Evidence types the worker must produce on completion. Enum constrains to known evidence categories.

supersedes_run_id.description: Optional. If present, this envelope amends a prior dispatch. Points to the run_id being superseded. The envelope is immutable; amendment means a new envelope, not an edit.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the envelope was created
